clause: PPN observables are extracted by a fixed linear readout P_PPN from the already coarse-grained metric perturbation in one chosen local PPN/Fermi patch.
S_ell acts on metric/source fields before fixed PPN observable coefficients are read out.
Cassini ray/impact geometry belongs to the external observable model, not to P_PPN(x) inside S_ell.
Use one local Fermi/frame patch over the smoothing support; frame drift is counted as curvature-order, not a first-order adaptive readout.
Public EM/radiation/matter flux is included in T_mu_nu / Hilbert source measure before hidden MTS boundary residuals are scored.
The local scalar smoothing kernel is normalized, radial/even in the tangent/Fermi patch and selected before scoring.
Optional extension: fixed annulus, fixed primitive, trivial relative class, source-blind reference and positive M_H_ref.
